title: Anthropic completes a $119.5 billion share offering
teaser: Anthropic has completed its IPO and a parallel private placement. The company sold 1.103 billion Class A shares at $83 apiece, while shareholders sold another 23.6 million. With the banks exercising their option in full to buy an additional 147 million shares, the total offering reached 1.127 billion shares. Anthropic received about $91.6 billion of the IPO’s $93.5 billion in gross proceeds. Seven companies, including Google, Microsoft and NVIDIA, bought another 313.3 million Class N shares for $26 billion. Gross proceeds from the IPO and private placement combined reached about $119.5 billion.
